findings.text: the catalog validation receipt is vacuous because the reviewed worktree contains zero standard-name YAML entries; it proves that the pinned 0.9.3 tool installs and exits cleanly, but not that the forthcoming WEST catalog validates under that grammar, so the downstream populated-catalog gate remains required.

no automated assertion requires the intended published grammar version itself; uv lock --check catches a pyproject/lock mismatch, but a coordinated downgrade of both files would remain green, so durability is partial rather than complete.

repository guidance says uv.lock is only gitignored and must not be added, while uv.lock is tracked and this node's exact done-when required regenerating it; the reviewed change correctly followed the exact node contract and established pin-update history, but the stale guidance can misdirect the next pin bump.
